Issue #42: The Architecture of Local AI Agents

Gergely Orosz • Oct 15, 2026

Today we examine how developer tools are evolving from cloud wrappers into local-first, privacy-respecting browser extensions.

By executing lightweight intent models locally and maintaining strict content grounding, modern extensions eliminate hallucination while keeping developer source code safe on device.

Key takeaways include: zero unauthorized telemetry, bounded token budgets, and client-side AST inspection.
